payload.title: Build the site cyclotron definition from the Section list
payload.description: Backend. One CyclotronDefinition for the whole site: one binary classifier per enabled NewsroomSection (question and rubric seeded from the Section's editorial mission, policy and kill criteria) and one multi-class 'section' classifier whose labels are the Section ids. Config: relevanceCyclotron stays for the relevance question; add siteCyclotron with the same enabled flag, daily cap and approvedProofPath. Replaces the single-classifier assumption (classifiers[0]) across relevance_sweep, relevance_decisions and relevance_shadow.
